bio: Houston Alexander Gaines (born January 11, 1995) is an American politician from Georgia. Gaines has been a Republican member of the Georgia House of Representatives since 2019.
offices: Member of the Georgia House of Representatives

items.t: Helped introduce 2023 legislation creating a panel with state oversight of district attorneys and making it easier for residents to recall prosecutors.
items.q: Gaines helped introduce legislation to create a panel that would give the state more oversight over district attorneys and make it easier for residents to recall prosecutors.

items.t: Pushed legislation addressing prosecutors, saying it is time to take on "rogue prosecutors" in Georgia.
items.q: “It is past time we take on rogue prosecutors in Georgia who are putting lives in danger every single day.”

items.t: Sponsored legislation that Governor Brian Kemp signed in May 2023, establishing the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualifications Commission (PAQC).
items.q: In May 2023, Georgia Governor Brian Kemp signed the bill into law, establishing the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualifications Commission (PAQC).
